beats.text: The company behind Claude just pulled off the biggest IPO in history. And its rivals helped pay for it.
beats.dir: big, gripping news hook with a twist

beats.text: Anthropic priced its shares at eighty-three dollars — above its own target range.
That raised over eighty billion dollars. More than SpaceX's record.
At that price, the whole company was worth about one and a half trillion.
beats.dir: slow down on the number, awe

beats.text: Claude first launched in 2023. Three years later — a trillion-dollar company.
Day one, the stock opened thirty-four percent higher… then cooled to close up seventeen.
Now the strange part: Google, Microsoft and Nvidia bought billions in shares alongside the IPO.
Why? They build the chips and the cloud that AI runs on.
So every time an AI company wins, the companies selling the shovels win too.
